title: WF03 OBS-01 integration blocker: TC-OBS-01-INT-01 lacked token-gated harness precondition and surfaced connection-refused failures

root_cause.description: TC-OBS-01-INT-01 in tests/integration/trace_test.zig did not enforce the same BPM_TEST_TOKEN precondition used by the other HTTP trace integration tests, so partially configured harness runs attempted live HTTP calls and failed with connection refused.

resolution.summary: Applied the minimal harness fix in tests/integration/trace_test.zig by requiring BPM_TEST_TOKEN in TC-OBS-01-INT-01, keeping the request itself unauthenticated while aligning precondition gating with the rest of the trace integration suite.

actions: Keep environment precondition handling consistent for all tests within tests/integration/trace_test.zig.
Treat token presence as harness readiness gating only where requests are intentionally unauthenticated.
